identity.name: Sustain
identity.visual_mood: Digital Organic - where clean tech meets natural textures

layout_strategies.safe_area: All screens must use SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context
layout_strategies.containers: Use Flexbox for everything. Main containers usually flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.background.primary
layout_strategies.cards: Use View with borderRadius.lg, backgroundColor: colors.background.secondary, and padding.md
layout_strategies.lists: Use FlatList for performance. Add contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 100 }} to avoid bottom tab overlap
layout_strategies.touch_targets: Ensure all TouchableOpacity/Pressable have minHeight: 48 and minWidth: 48

MicButton.description: Central floating action button for voice input. Must pulse when active.
MicButton.animation: Pulse scale from 1 to 1.1 repeatedly when active state is true

InventoryItem.description: Swipeable list item. Left swipe (Green/Used), Right swipe (Red/Wasted).
InventoryItem.layout: Row with image/icon on left, text details in middle, expiry badge on right

technical_constraints.styling: Use StyleSheet.create(). NO styled-components. NO Tailwind classes (unless using NativeWind, but assume StyleSheet for raw React Native).
technical_constraints.theme: Dark Mode Default. No light mode toggle required for MVP.
technical_constraints.animations: Use react-native-reanimated for complex animations (mic pulse, swipe) and LayoutAnimation for simple list updates.
technical_constraints.navigation: Use standard React Navigation Bottom Tabs with transparent background and blur effect if possible (expo-blur).

universal_guidelines: Design for thumbs: Important actions at the bottom.
Feedback is key: Every voice command must have visual confirmation (ripple, text transcript).
Zero Clutter: If it doesn't help reduce waste, remove it.
Speed: The user should be in and out in 10 seconds. Auto-categorize voice input.
Accessibility: Ensure high contrast text (#F5F5DC on #0A0A0A) passes WCAG AAA.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup navigation with a custom Tab Bar that hosts the floating Mic button in the center.
2. Implement the Voice Interface first - it is the core feature.
3. Use the 'InventoryItem' component structure for the list.
4. Ensure swipe gestures work smoothly using Reanimated Swipeable.
5. Mock the Voice-to-Text if API keys are missing, but build the UI to handle the 'Listening' state.
